summary.zh: 北上冀州。漳水边的邺城年年给河伯娶妇，祠后的深水里有鼎在呼吸。揭开河伯的真身，破开洛书之封，第一鼎归来——练气圆满者，在此筑基。
summary.en: North into Ji. On the Zhang, the city of Ye marries a bride to the River Lord every year, and in the deep water behind the shrine a cauldron is breathing. Unmask the River Lord, break the Luo seal, and the first cauldron returns — one at the peak of Qi Condensation lays their Foundation here.

intro.zh: 北上冀州。漳水边的邺城年年给河伯娶妇——一个姑娘穿了红衣，送下水去。祠后的深水里，有什么在呼吸。
intro.en: North into Ji. Every year the city of Ye on the Zhang gives the River Lord a bride — a girl in red, sent into the water. In the deep water behind the shrine something is breathing.

mystery.zh: 邺城年年送下水的新娘，嫁的是谁？
mystery.en: Whom do the brides Ye sends into the water really marry?
